attributes.title: Level 2

subgroups.name: solve 1

steps.hints: ❓ What should the value in the run condition expression be updated to, so that 10 Fly sprites appear?
steps.senseiHelp:
Ask the ninja: 

❓ Which value should be updated in the for loop so that 10 Fly sprites appear?


Solution: 

The value in the run condition expression of the for loop should be changed to 10.
steps.instructions:
When the project runs, only 2 Fly sprites appear on the screen!


Fix the bugs in the code so that 10 Fly sprites appear on the screen.

subgroups.title: Debugging For Loops
subgroups.introduction: Oh no - these programs aren’t working! Problems in code are called bugs. Find and fix the bugs in the code in each section!

validationItems.text: Value in run condition expression of for loop changed to 10.
validationItems.failureText: Try updating the value in the run condition expression of the for loop.

subgroups.name: solve 2

steps.hints: ❓ Where should the setVelocity and setBounceOnWall code be moved so that the Fly sprites are set to move on their own and bounce on walls?
steps.senseiHelp:
Ask the ninja: 

❓ Where should code be placed in order for it to be run on each of the for loop’s iterations?


Solution: 

setVelocity and setBounceOnWall code should be moved inside the for loop’s block statement.
steps.instructions:
When the project runs, there’s an error in the code!


Notice that the error message on the bottom says the problem is on Lines 174 and 175: the program cannot find the name ‘flySprite’.  



Fix the bugs in the code so that when the project begins, 10 Fly sprites are placed in random positions, move on their own, and bounce on walls.

attributes.description: You’ve reached Level 2 of Purple Belt! In this level, you’ll learn more about for loops. Using for loops, you can code things to happen multiple times. Here are the achievements you’ll unlock in Level 2:

badges.title: Getting Loopy
badges.description: Control how a loop runs using its 3 expressions in JavaScript.

badges.title: Here We Go Again
badges.description: Write a for loop that starts at zero and counts up using an increment operator.

badges.title: Where it Stops, Nobody Knows
badges.description: Write a for loop that runs a random number of times.

badges.title: Sugar, We’re Going Down
badges.description: Write a for loop that starts with a number larger than zero and counts down using a decrement operator.

badges.title: Double the Fun
badges.description: Nest a for loop inside another for loop.

badges.title: Memory Palace
badges.description: Save the game’s high score.

badges.title: Trophy Room
badges.description: Display the high score to the user.

badges.title: Depth Perception
badges.description: Set a sprite’s z-position so it appears in the front of a scene.
